Type: desk
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Wood and Metal Hairpin Small Table Desk, 47.2"W, Walnut
Colors: Walnut
Materials: walnut veneer
47.2"W x 22.2"D x 30.9"H Metal legs with warm walnut wood veneer Highly functional with large work space and three storage compartments on the back edge Add industrial style to your home office or study space with this practical desk. Featuring a mix of engineered wood, walnut veneer, and metal, it provides ample storage and work space. The uniquely designed hairpin legs are both sturdy and sleek. Easy assembly in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
